answer: The linchpin is Miller millstone bake log stamped by the bakers company: remove it and the farm walks in; keep it and the farm pays each millstone is a dated grind ticket plus a signed mill log, so a farm must mill 4 per alias. Minutes add up the same way: 13 for one, 8827 for 679, and the farm pays in afternoons it never gets back. Follow the haven back to the office that issued it, follow the gale back to the wallet that paid it, and follow the trellis back to the year it was filed. The price is the same for everyone; the farm simply has to pay it a hundred times.
